timeline_convention: Controls are presented at absolute frame zero and sanitized into one coherent accepted Controls value at the next persistent 16-frame quantum. A changed effect-clear generation clears all modal and duck state before the first sample of that quantum. Each lane boundary and local accepted trigger occurs before only that lane's source render. Seven voices render in fixed lane order with their source random context restored immediately before and saved immediately after each call. Signed 64-bit main/aux sums then feed the exact dry branch and the shared cohesion branch; smoothing and final mix advance once per sample. Outer host blocks only copy persistent carry and never realign scheduler, source random, smoothing, modal, mixer, or snapshot state.

tolerances.all_24_model_labels: exact equality with the 24-entry proposal and compiled modelName table
tolerances.clear_effect_output: all six complex modes and duck envelope are exact zero before the affected quantum's first sample; with all Voice Levels zero, every subsequent PCM byte is zero
tolerances.clear_noninterference: accepted seven lane/voice records, phase, remainder, step/address, trigger counts, source RNG states, transport, and parameters are exact against a no-clear reference
tolerances.cohere_comparator: PAMP_R04_COHERE and PAMP_R04_DRY_CMP have unequal PCM and effect-state SHA-256 with positive dry-difference energy
tolerances.dry_bypass: after Cohere's declared snap to zero, PCM is byte-exact to the signed-64-bit seven-voice dry reference regardless of Drive or modal parameters
tolerances.global_isolation: global continuous controls and Global/Clear gestures change zero bytes in all seven accepted LaneControls and VoiceControls records
tolerances.partition_pcm_event_snapshot_controller_: byte exact within one frozen build for 1, 16, 64, 128, 257, and 512 frame hosts
tolerances.source_main_and_aux_non_silent: RMS greater than zero for every model sweep channel
tolerances.tail_before_clear: finite nonzero PCM and at least one nonzero modal state sample after all seven Voice Levels become zero
tolerances.voice_control_isolation: changing one target voice or lane field changes zero bytes in all six non-target accepted records and their pre-mix source state
